name: seshi-cursor
description: Shows in Cursor's status bar whether seshi captures the chat you have open, and turns it off or on with a click.

commands.title: seshi: Turn Session Capture off or on for this chat
seshi: Choose the chat to turn off or on

seshi.command.description: The seshi program to run. Empty: the one seshi capture install wrote into ~/.cursor/hooks.json, else seshi on the PATH.

seshi.useCursorInternals.description: Ask Cursor which chats are open through an undocumented command, to show the chat you are looking at. Off: the chat you last sent a message in.
